response.overview: It all begins with the purchase of an old camera and the discovery of a small USB stick containing a mysterious video. When Kian, Moha, and Vale examine the footage, they uncover a disturbing recording of a nightmarish figure lurking in the woods. They quickly realize that there is far more at stake than they initially thought: the entire town of Wangen seems to be under the grip of a dark secret. But just as Kian, Moha, and Vale begin their investigation, mysterious adversaries emerge—determined to stay one step ahead of them at any cost…
response.title: SPOT - Der Fluch von Wangen
